text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr has been in a slump
lately, so we
decide to go to a shrine
together to pray.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for taking the time out of
your
schedule to join me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It's felt as if I've had a sable squall
clinging to my
very body...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fwooshhh...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh? This feels...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The wind just now felt very gentle.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It wrapped me in its warm embrace... as
if it
wanted to play.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
So I'm surrendering my body to that
wind. And
besides, a peculiar lightness
has come over me as
well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't really understand what she's
saying, but it
sounds like the wind might
be blowing her way
again soon...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's.
choice_data_list: それじゃあ、お参りをしようか
choice_data_list_en: Well then, shall we pay our respects?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr quietly brings her hands

together and prays.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I can only hope that my wishes ride the
winds and
make their way to the gods.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fwooshhh...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...A gentle wind. Thank you. That makes
me feel
better.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'll express my gratitude by giving rise to
a fresh
breeze on the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From that day on, Yamanin Zephyr
miraculously
starts to recover from her
slump.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh? The wind stopped...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
My prayers might struggle to reach the
gods now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With no wind blowing, the dejected
Yamanin
Zephyr fails to break out of her
slump.
